authority_invariant: The organic control plane senses, records, assesses and proposes bounded dispositions. It cannot manufacture provider, merge, release, economic, legal, rights, security, credential, governance or D3 authority.

systems.purpose: Deterministically assess evidence-backed organ health, capacity pressure, redundancy and cost, retain bounded learning trends, and produce non-authorizing dispositions.
systems.human_surface: Whole-body assessments, reasons, trends and candidate dispositions
systems.authority_boundary: Assessment and learning are advisory; all consequential effects require the independently governed target authority gate.

five_stage.discover: Receive fresh authenticated signals through PentaNerves.
five_stage.govern: Apply identity, freshness, idempotency, health, load, cost and redundancy rules.
five_stage.verify: Seal the assessment into PentaSpine and verify its chain.
five_stage.preserve: Retain reasons and non-authorizing learning summaries.

systems.purpose: Provide an ordered append-only hash-chained JSONL event backbone with fsync persistence, replay validation and duplicate-signal rejection.
systems.human_surface: Integrity, sequence, replay and continuity state
systems.authority_boundary: A durable receipt preserves evidence but never proves external delivery, provider state or authority beyond its recorded scope.

five_stage.govern: Enforce schema, sequence, idempotency and redaction.
five_stage.execute: Append, hash-chain, flush and fsync the event.
five_stage.verify: Replay the complete chain and reject corruption.
five_stage.preserve: Expose sanitized continuity evidence to PentaBody.

systems.purpose: Route afferent observations, efferent governed candidates and lateral peer receipts through explicit identity, freshness, idempotency and readback contracts.
systems.human_surface: Signal routes, source identity, freshness, destination and disposition
systems.authority_boundary: Reachability and routing do not grant permission; unknown routes and sources fail closed.

five_stage.govern: Validate schema, source, direction, time and idempotency.
five_stage.execute: Route through the registered afferent, efferent or lateral path.
five_stage.verify: Require the destination receipt and spine integrity.
five_stage.preserve: Retain only public-safe identity and disposition evidence.

systems.purpose: Compose a sanitized whole-system Command Center projection from verified PentaSpine events without exposing private payloads, keys, provider coordinates or raw signatures.
systems.human_surface: Command Center health, load, disposition and continuity projection
systems.authority_boundary: The projection describes bounded evidence and cannot promote maturity, certify deployment or authorize remediation.

five_stage.govern: Apply public-safe projection and bounded history rules.
five_stage.execute: Compose whole-body counts and organ state.
five_stage.verify: Reject non-finite values or broken spine integrity.
five_stage.preserve: Hash the Command Center snapshot for downstream readback.

systems.purpose: Measure finite bounded load, capacity and utilization, including safe zero-capacity semantics, for PentaBrain and PentaBalancer.
systems.human_surface: Demand, capacity, utilization and pressure evidence
systems.authority_boundary: Measurement cannot allocate resources, incur cost or shed service without a separately authorized disposition.

five_stage.discover: Collect bounded demand and capacity values.
five_stage.execute: Calculate utilization with explicit zero-capacity semantics.
five_stage.preserve: Feed the sealed assessment into PentaSpine.

systems.purpose: Propose redundancy restoration, load shedding, bounded growth and graceful recession while preserving reserve capacity and cost limits.
systems.human_surface: Capacity and redundancy recommendations with reasons
systems.authority_boundary: Balancer output is candidate-only and cannot provision, terminate, spend or move workloads without exact target authority and readback.

five_stage.discover: Read health, load, redundancy and cost evidence.
five_stage.govern: Apply reserve, cost, risk and authority limits.
five_stage.verify: Require exact authority and readback before any external effect.
five_stage.preserve: Retain the candidate and its reasons without self-promotion.
